propositions: No AST gate currently proves that only approved composition roots and provider boundaries read ambient config and credentials; below-seam reads can silently appear

An AST gate must detect six prohibited access categories (ambient env read, helper-shim env read, load_config call, literal-getattr env equivalent, provider-credential read, configurable adapter default) with receiver-object alias resolution and reuse gen_env_registry machinery

The owner registry must derive credential names from _child_env, backend keys from static @register decorators, and env baseline from gen_env_registry.scan + _deprecations, rejecting path-glob exceptions structurally
A legacy-exception set for current below-seam reads must be introduced to make the gate deliverable without product changes, with C3 draining it to empty
Synthetic fixtures must fail with expected diagnostics for each of the six categories (direct/import-aliased/local-aliased forms), and clean approved fixtures must pass without findings
The gate must run offline with no network dependency, expose check(root)->list[str] and main(argv)->int contract, and exit 0 on the current tree
